user.title: Hik-Connect account
user.description: Enter the Hik-Connect username and password that owns the intercom.

device.title: Select device
device.description: Choose the indoor station or other Hik-Connect device that contains the linked intercom channels.

channel.title: Select linked channel
channel.description: Choose the linked camera channel to expose as a Home Assistant camera.

error.auth: Hik-Connect rejected the username or password.
error.no_devices: The account returned no available devices.
error.no_channels: The selected device returned no available linked channels.

abort.already_configured: This device channel is already configured.

init.title: Stream options
init.description: Choose the output mode. RTSP copy mode needs an external RTSP server such as MediaMTX. Both keeps the legacy HTTP outputs during migration.

data.output_mode: Output mode (legacy HTTP, RTSP copy, or both)
data.relay_host: Relay hostname or IP for stream consumers
